mutants.why: A bare `ev.target` read in the sign-off's stream: every legacy target-less Strike draw lands in cbDraw, so a month that drew $1,000 prefills "Expenses actually paid" at $0.00 and confirmMonth writes 0 to expensesActual.

mutants.why: deriveCurrentPosition trusts the log's order: an unsorted monthlyLog (setMonthlyLog, a raw pull, a restored backup) puts the Advisor position card's Strike balance and last logged month on whichever entry came last — month 1's $3,000 instead of month 3's $9,000.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v11 migration
mutants.why: The v11 btcHeld backfill made unconditional: migrateState runs on EVERY bump, so the next one overwrites each month's RECORDED Strike col (0.62 ₿ from its reading) with the running chain (baseline + cumulative buys) — the chain journal.md's v20 row deleted.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v11 migration
mutants.why: The v11 expensesActual default made unconditional: the next bump replaces every month's actual expenses — the sign-off's signed $2,500 — with the plan's static $3,500 assumption.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v19 migration
mutants.why: The v19 backfill made unconditional ("only where undefined" dropped): the next bump signs every open month — confirmed:false (awaiting sign-off, or reopened by an edit) becomes confirmed:true with no review.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v19 migration
mutants.why: The v19 source backfill made unconditional: the next bump stamps every daily-owned month source:'manual' — the M2 guard stops protecting the Ledger's months from Monthly/Advisor writes.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v19 migration
mutants.why: The C2 seed loses its empty-journal guard: every later bump appends another synthetic cbCollateralReading (dated the migration day, 1.48 ₿) to an existing journal, which then syncs as if the owner had logged it — ONE seed becomes one per bump.

mutants.rule: .claude/rules/store.md — Zustand v20 migration
mutants.why: The v20 cache-seed ignores the stored cache: at the next bump an owner whose collateral no reading states (getCurrentBtcHeld = the cache, 0.80 ₿) is re-seeded from the last entry's btcHeld + pending (a corrected 0.62 ₿) — current collateral moves across a migration that must leave it byte-identical.
